CIN-00.title: 序幕：遲到的邀請
lines: 山路上的故障耽誤了行程。凌晨三點，我才抵達。
A breakdown delayed my journey. I arrived at three in the morning.
林依瑤私下請我保護她。她留下的邀請函，署名王杰倫。
Lin Yiyao had privately asked for my protection. Her copy of the invitation was signed Wang Jielun.
聚會的小屋，只剩下仍在冒煙的廢墟。
The gathering place was a smoking ruin.
警方通報四具成年人焦屍，身分待驗；起火原因仍在調查。
Police reported four adult bodies, identification pending. The cause of the fire was still under investigation.
火勢已撲滅。我只獲准進入當晚確認的安全調查區。
The fire was out. I could enter only the areas cleared for investigation that night.

CIN-A.title: 客房：灰燼裡的謊言
lines: 林依瑤的筆記，藏在燒毀的行李之中。
Lin Yiyao’s notes were hidden in the burned luggage.
她把能繼續追查的線索壓了下來，將事件寫成懸案。
She had suppressed leads that could be pursued, reporting the case as an unsolved mystery.
那封威脅信，讓這次聚會有了另一種意味。
The threatening letter cast a different light on the gathering.
紙上的紀錄留下疑點，還不足以指認犯人。
The records raised questions, but did not identify a culprit.
EVIDENCE-01
三只杯子與空瓶，留下了尚待交叉比對的痕跡。
Three glasses and an empty bottle left traces that needed corroboration.

CIN-B.title: 暗房：不在照片裡的人
lines: 被光線吞沒的影像，重新浮現。
An image lost in the light began to emerge.
十八點三十分的第一張照片裡，劉涵仍在。
Liu Han was present in the first photograph, taken at 18:30.
二十點的最後合照，鏡頭前三人，加上攝影師劉子傑，共四人。
At 20:00, three people faced the camera; with the photographer Liu Zijie, four.
劉涵不在照片裡。缺席本身，還不能證明死亡。
Liu Han was absent. Absence alone could not prove death.

CIN-C.title: 營火：善意與異常重量
lines: 劉涵帶來烤肉架，原本只是想讓朋友開心。
Liu Han brought the grill hoping to cheer up a friend.
日記裡的道歉，與儲藏室停在十九點十五分的破錶，需要交叉核對。
The diary’s apology and the storage-room watch stopped at 19:15 needed corroboration.
預定食材只有五公斤，歷史紀錄卻留下六十五公斤。
The planned food weighed five kilograms. The historical record showed sixty-five.
固定底座保存了十九點十五分的歷史紀錄，控制器卻不在座上。
The fixed base retained the 19:15 record, but its detachable controller was missing.
烤架下的六角項鍊，與第一張照片裡的輪廓一致。
The hexagonal pendant beneath the grill matched the first photograph.

CIN-D.title: 診療區：另一種飢餓
lines: 張萍的深層報告，記錄了極度飢餓與疑似食用親屬遺體的往事。
Zhang Ping’s deeper report recorded extreme hunger and suspected consumption of relatives’ remains.
烤肉的氣味，可能喚醒的不是恐懼，而是食慾。
Perhaps the smell of the grill awakened appetite rather than fear.
拍攝紀錄與現場痕跡，需要相互交叉，不能只靠一份病歷定罪。
Recording logs and scene traces required corroboration. A medical record alone could not establish guilt.
當晚只能確認四具遺體，正式身分仍待後續核對。
Only the count of four bodies was confirmed that night. Formal identification would follow later.
鐵櫃在火災中倒下；原先的出口，並非一直被它堵住。
The cabinet fell during the fire. It had not always blocked the exit.
門框先被使用，細灰後來才覆上；痕跡仍不能單獨辨認使用者。
The frame was used before ash settled. The traces alone could not identify who used it.
主門反鎖，地下室卻有對外維修出口。王杰倫可能已經離開。
The main door was bolted, but a basement maintenance exit led outside. Wang Jielun might have escaped.

CIN-END.title: 終幕：深淵的凝視
lines: END-01
那條出口，讓另一種可能浮現。
The exit left another possibility.
END-02
我朝森林出口奔去，身後的黑暗卻留在原地。
I ran toward the forest exit. The darkness behind me remained.
END-03
樹洞裡，有人一直朝著這裡。
Someone in the hollow tree was facing this way.
END-04
［吞嚥聲］［感測器歸零音］
[Swallowing sound] [Sensor reset tone]
END-05
冷光照亮了那張熟悉的臉。王杰倫還活著。
The cold light revealed a familiar face. Wang Jielun was alive.
END-06
真正的怪物，早已隱入這片漆黑的森林之中。
The true monster had already vanished into the dark forest.
